column15: Addictive block-clearing puzzle game. Drag vibrant shapes onto 8x8 board, complete rows/columns, and trigger combo blasts!
Unscrew bolts and untangle metal sheets and wooden plates in this brain-teasing physics puzzle!
Hilarious and unforgiving troll platformer with unexpected traps and moving obstacles.
Connect all dots with a continuous single stroke in this addictive, brain-challenging line puzzle!
Direct laser beams through prisms and mirrors to activate targets in this optics logic puzzle!
Manage your own supermarket in Monkey Mart! Plant crops, harvest fresh bananas, stock displays, serve customers, and expand your monkey grocery empire!
